description: This file defines the AuthenticationException class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base Exception class, uses a trait for internationalization support, and provides a set of predefined static methods to generate specific exception instances related to authentication errors.

classes.name: AuthenticationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling authentication-related errors within OrangeHRM. Provides static methods to instantiate specific error types with standardized messages and supports internationalization.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the exception with error code and localized message.

methods.name: employeeNotAssigned
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the employee is not assigned.

methods.name: employeeTerminated
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the employee has been terminated.

methods.name: userDisabled
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the user account is disabled.

methods.name: invalidCredentials
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating invalid login credentials.

methods.name: invalidCsrfToken
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating CSRF token validation failure.

methods.name: invalidResetCode
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating an invalid password reset code.

methods.name: noUserFound
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating no user was found.

methods.name: multipleUserReturned
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating multiple users were returned where only one was expected.

methods.name: sessionExpired
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the session has expired.
